Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

table = Asset('table')
table.include('top', box((1.4,.8,.08), center=(0,0,.75), color=(.4,.2,.1)))
for x in (-.6,.6):
    for y in (-.3,.3):
        table.include(f'leg_{x}_{y}', box((.07,.07,.7), center=(x,y,.35)))
scene.include('table', table)
scene.include('floor', box((6,6,.1), center=(0,0,-.05), color=(.6,.6,.6)))
realize(scene)
set_view((3,-4,2), (0,0,.7), lens=40)
area_emitter((0,-2,4), power=1000)

from sceneact import *
import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector

random.seed(19)
scene = Scene(name="Classroom")
cream=(.79,.775,.69)
blue=(.018,.12,.32)
green=(.045,.145,.080)
wood=(.72,.40,.13)
steel=(.57,.59,.55)

scene.include("wall",box((14,.18,6.5),center=(0,1.43,3.25),color=cream))
scene.include("blue_wall",box((14,.035,1.51),center=(0,1.315,.755),color=blue))
scene.include("floor",box((14,13,.10),center=(0,-3,-.07),color=(.46,.29,.16)))
scene.include("skirting",box((14,.055,.065),center=(0,1.275,.032),color=(.63,.48,.30)))

board=Asset("Large worn green chalkboard")
board.include("backing",box((5.74,.07,1.94),center=(0,1.23,2.14),color=(.26,.29,.21)))
for i,x in enumerate((-1.4275,1.4275)):
    board.include("green_panel_"+str(i),box((2.845,.025,1.90),center=(x,1.18,2.14),color=green))
for z in (1.181,3.099):
    board.include("horizontal_rim_"+str(z),box((5.73,.028,.019),center=(0,1.153,z),color=(.37,.40,.29)))
for x in (-2.86,.005,2.86):
    board.include("vertical_rim_"+str(x),box((.016,.028,1.92),center=(x,1.153,2.14),color=(.32,.36,.25)))
scene.include("chalkboard",board)

# Uneven vertical wiping traces and faint remnants of chalk.
marks=Asset("Chalk dust and eraser traces")
for i in range(112):
    x=random.uniform(.07,2.81)
    low=random.uniform(1.20,1.70)
    high=random.uniform(2.70,3.08)
    c=random.choice([(.13,.23,.135),(.20,.29,.17),(.27,.34,.21),(.105,.20,.12)])
    pts=[]
    for j in range(15):
        z=low+(high-low)*j/14
        xx=x+.018*math.sin(j*.65+i)+.015*math.sin(j*.21+i*2)
        pts.append((xx,1.161-random.uniform(0,.002),z))
    marks.include("vertical_wipe_%d"%i,sweep_tube(points=pts,radius=random.uniform(.002,.009),color=c))
for i in range(54):
    x=random.uniform(-2.8,-.12)
    z=random.uniform(1.22,2.95)
    length=random.uniform(.12,.61)
    pts=[(x+.018*math.sin(j*.8+i),1.159,z+length*j/10) for j in range(11)]
    pts=[(a,b,min(c,3.065)) for a,b,c in pts]
    marks.include("left_drip_%d"%i,sweep_tube(points=pts,radius=random.uniform(.002,.006),color=(.26,.37,.24)))
for i in range(34):
    cx=random.uniform(-2.5,-.45)
    cz=random.uniform(2.30,2.89)
    rx=random.uniform(.23,.67)
    rz=random.uniform(.07,.30)
    start=random.uniform(-1.1,1.0)
    pts=[]
    for j in range(23):
        a=start+j*.075
        xx=cx+rx*math.cos(a)
        zz=cz+rz*math.sin(a)
        if -2.80<xx<-.04 and 1.22<zz<3.07:
            pts.append((xx,1.151,zz))
    if len(pts)>2:
        marks.include("curved_eraser_%d"%i,sweep_tube(points=pts,radius=random.uniform(.003,.012),color=random.choice([(.19,.29,.18),(.26,.35,.23),(.12,.23,.14)])))
for i in range(100):
    x=random.uniform(-2.80,2.80)
    z=random.uniform(1.22,3.06)
    if random.random()<.65:
        marks.include("chalk_speck_%d"%i,box((random.uniform(.004,.018),.002,random.uniform(.006,.026)),center=(x,1.143,z),color=(.46,.51,.33)))
scene.include("dust",marks)

# The small classroom notice above the board.
notice=Asset("Wall notice")
notice.include("paper_back",box((1.025,.023,.80),center=(.22,1.27,3.77),color=(.65,.61,.49)))
notice.include("paper",box((1.00,.008,.775),center=(.22,1.251,3.775),color=(.83,.80,.71)))
for x in (-.265,.705):
    notice.include("border_v"+str(x),box((.006,.004,.74),center=(x,1.244,3.775),color=(.58,.49,.37)))
for z in (3.407,4.143):
    notice.include("border_h"+str(z),box((.97,.004,.006),center=(.22,1.244,z),color=(.58,.49,.37)))
notice.include("hanger_left",rod(.002,start=(-.275,1.265,4.17),end=(.22,1.275,4.57),color=(.48,.43,.32)))
notice.include("hanger_right",rod(.002,start=(.72,1.265,4.17),end=(.22,1.275,4.57),color=(.48,.43,.32)))
for col in range(3):
    cx=-.20+col*.31
    for row in range(20):
        z=4.08-row*.030
        for k in range(random.randint(1,3)):
            xx=cx+k*.075
            w=random.uniform(.025,.065)
            notice.include("print_%d_%d_%d"%(col,row,k),box((w,.003,random.uniform(.002,.005)),center=(xx,1.237,z),color=(.40,.38,.33)))
notice.include("heading",box((.37,.003,.008),center=(.22,1.236,4.11),color=(.40,.35,.30)))
scene.include("notice",notice)
scene.include("wall_fixture",rod(.052,start=(-.49,1.30,3.98),end=(-.49,1.24,3.98),color=(.16,.13,.10)))
scene.include("fixture_glint",ball(.014,center=(-.50,1.233,3.995),color=(.55,.49,.36)))

def desk(name,x,y,width=2.65,depth=.70,height=.85,pale=False):
    a=Asset(name)
    topcolor=(.83,.60,.28) if not pale else (.79,.73,.60)
    a.include("top",fillet_box((width,depth,.065),radius=.035,center=(x,y,height),color=topcolor))
    a.include("front_edge",box((width-.055,.023,.025),center=(x,y-depth/2-.002,height-.018),color=(.71,.43,.15) if not pale else (.65,.57,.43)))
    for xx in (x-width/2+.12,x+width/2-.12):
        for yy in (y-depth/2+.10,y+depth/2-.10):
            a.include("leg_%s_%s"%(xx,yy),rod(.022,start=(xx,yy,.03),end=(xx,yy,height-.04),color=steel))
        a.include("side_rail"+str(xx),rod(.016,start=(xx,y-depth/2+.10,.30),end=(xx,y+depth/2-.10,.30),color=steel))
    a.include("under_rail",rod(.018,start=(x-width/2+.12,y+.17,height-.14),end=(x+width/2-.12,y+.17,height-.14),color=(.42,.44,.39)))
    for xx in (x-width/2+.12,x+width/2-.12):
        a.include("front_bracket"+str(xx),box((.055,.045,.15),center=(xx,y-depth/2+.09,height-.12),color=(.58,.56,.45)))
    scene.include(name,a)

def chair(name,x,y,back_top=1.10,width=.65):
    a=Asset(name)
    a.include("seat",fillet_box((width,.48,.045),radius=.025,center=(x,y,.48),color=(.65,.34,.11)))
    back=box((width,.042,.26),center=(x,y+.20,back_top-.13),color=(.65,.35,.12))
    back.turn('Y',-3)
    a.include("wood_back",back)
    for xx in (x-width/2+.045,x+width/2-.045):
        a.include("back_support"+str(xx),rod(.017,start=(xx,y+.22,.05),end=(xx,y+.22,back_top-.045),color=(.57,.59,.53)))
        a.include("front_leg"+str(xx),rod(.020,start=(xx,y-.19,.025),end=(xx,y-.19,.48),color=steel))
        a.include("side_join"+str(xx),rod(.014,start=(xx,y-.19,.25),end=(xx,y+.22,.25),color=steel))
    scene.include(name,a)

chair("Chair behind middle desk",-1.12,.72,1.10,.64)
desk("Middle desk",-.69,-.10,2.67,.72,.86)
desk("Foreground left desk",-.83,-1.52,2.60,.72,.81)
chair("Foreground wooden chair",-1.28,-2.50,1.045,.67)
desk("Foreground right desk",2.53,-1.53,2.03,.76,.80,True)
chair("Right foreground chair",2.01,-2.47,1.035,.69)

realize(scene)

# Layered procedural surfaces retain the board's deep green beneath chalk dust.
def board_material():
    mat=bpy.data.materials.new("Mottled green slate with erased chalk")
    mat.use_nodes=True
    n=mat.node_tree.nodes
    l=mat.node_tree.links
    bs=n.get("Principled BSDF")
    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.83
    tex=n.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value=5
    tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value=4
    coord=n.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")
    mapping=n.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
    mapping.operation='MULTIPLY'
    mapping.inputs[1].default_value=(3,3,.5)
    l.new(coord.outputs["Generated"],mapping.inputs[0])
    l.new(mapping.outputs[0],tex.inputs["Vector"])
    ramp=n.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position=.16
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color=(.016,.063,.030,1)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position=.85
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(.115,.215,.112,1)
    l.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs[0])
    l.new(ramp.outputs["Color"],bs.inputs["Base Color"])
    bump=n.new("ShaderNodeBump")
    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.14
    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.012
    l.new(tex.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
    l.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])
    return mat
slate=board_material()
for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects:
    if obj.type=='MESH':
        for slot in obj.material_slots:
            if slot.material:
                c=slot.material.diffuse_color
                if abs(c[0]-green[0])<.005 and abs(c[1]-green[1])<.005 and abs(c[2]-green[2])<.005:
                    slot.material=slate

set_view((0,-8.8,2.65),(0,1.30,2.08),lens=50,sensor=36)
area_emitter((-3.8,-3.8,5.4),power=1050,size=4.2,target=(0,1.1,1.7),color=(1,.94,.80))
area_emitter((2,-4,4.4),power=160,size=5,target=(0,1,2),color=(.83,.89,1))
world=bpy.context.scene.world
world.use_nodes=True
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value=(.65,.68,.66,1)
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value=.35
sc=bpy.context.scene
sc.render.engine='CYCLES'
sc.cycles.samples=48
sc.render.resolution_x=512
sc.render.resolution_y=337
sc.render.resolution_percentage=100
sc.view_settings.view_transform='AgX'
sc.view_settings.look='AgX - Medium High Contrast'
sc.view_settings.exposure=.15

# Procedural slate and chalk dust avoid expensive stroke geometry.
def slate_material(name, right):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
    links = mat.node_tree.links
    bs = nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = .90
    coord = nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord")

    def noise(scale, detail, stretch):
        mapping = nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
        mapping.operation = "MULTIPLY"
        mapping.inputs[1].default_value = stretch
        links.new(coord.outputs["Generated"], mapping.inputs[0])
        tex = nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value = scale
        tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value = detail
        tex.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = .72
        links.new(mapping.outputs[0], tex.inputs["Vector"])
        return tex

    broad = noise(5, 3, (3.7, 1, .13) if right else (1.4, 1, 1.6))
    fine = noise(7, 2, (16, 1, .17) if right else (13, 1, .45))
    mix = nodes.new("ShaderNodeMixRGB")
    mix.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
    mix.inputs[0].default_value = .60
    links.new(broad.outputs["Fac"], mix.inputs[1])
    links.new(fine.outputs["Fac"], mix.inputs[2])
    ramp = nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = .12
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = (.017, .065, .029, 1)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = .69
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (
        (.32, .36, .20, 1) if right else (.22, .32, .19, 1))
    middle = ramp.color_ramp.elements.new(.42)
    middle.color = (.075, .16, .075, 1)
    links.new(mix.outputs[0], ramp.inputs[0])
    links.new(ramp.outputs[0], bs.inputs["Base Color"])
    return mat

for cx, cz, rx, rz in [
    (.67, .65, .24, .22), (.71, .73, .29, .17),
    (.57, .87, .35, .12), (.22, .83, .32, .095),
    (.72, .58, .21, .17)
]:
    subtract_node = nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
    subtract_node.operation = "SUBTRACT"
    subtract_node.inputs[1].default_value = (cx, 0, cz)
    links.new(coord.outputs["Generated"], subtract_node.inputs[0])
    scale_node = nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
    scale_node.operation = "MULTIPLY"
    scale_node.inputs[1].default_value = (1/rx, 0, 1/rz)
    links.new(subtract_node.outputs[0], scale_node.inputs[0])
    length_node = nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
    length_node.operation = "LENGTH"
    links.new(scale_node.outputs[0], length_node.inputs[0])
    ramp = nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
    ramp.color_ramp.elements.remove(ramp.color_ramp.elements[1])
    for pos, value in [(.0, 0), (.90, 0), (.97, .43), (1.02, .16), (1.07, 0)]:
        if pos == 0:
            el = ramp.color_ramp.elements[0]
        else:
            el = ramp.color_ramp.elements.new(pos)
        el.color = (value, value, value, 1)
    links.new(length_node.outputs["Value"], ramp.inputs[0])
    mix = nodes.new("ShaderNodeMixRGB")
    links.new(ramp.outputs[0], mix.inputs[0])
    links.new(previous, mix.inputs[1])
    mix.inputs[2].default_value = (.31, .40, .25, 1)
    previous = mix.outputs[0]
links.new(previous, base_socket)

                    slot.material = right_mat

world = bpy.context.scene.world
world.use_nodes = True
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value = (.65, .68, .66, 1)
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value = .35
